children: Asana, Inc. (NYSE: ASAN)(LTSE: ASAN), the operating system for human-agent teams, today announced that Asana’s executives will present at the following investor events:
Citi's 2026 Global TMT Conference on September 9, 2026 at 7:10 a.m. PT / 10:10 a.m. ET
Piper Sandler Growth Frontiers Conference on September 15, 2026 at 11:30 a.m. PT / 2:30 p.m. ET
A live webcast will be available on Asana’s website at

Asana is the operating system for human-agent teams. Built on 18 years of foundational architecture, the enterprise Work Graph®, multiplayer collaboration, shared memory, and governance, it is exactly what the agentic era requires: a place where humans and agents run critical workflows together, on the same plan, toward the same goals — unlocking enterprise productivity.
